name: Boxing fitness
summary: How expats start boxing fitness in Singapore — pad-work gyms, beginner fundamentals, sparring opt-in norms, and heat-aware training schedules.
body:
Boxing fitness gyms emphasise pads, footwork, and conditioning more than competition sparring. Beginners should learn stance and hand-wrapping before chasing heavy-bag power in humid heat.

## Formats
- Beginner fundamentals classes
- Pad-work small groups
- Personal coaching packages
- Optional technical sparring (consent-first)
- Women-only or quiet-hour sessions where offered

Ask about glove hire vs buying your own 12–16 oz pair.

## How to choose
Prefer coaches who correct guard and hip rotation before combo speed. Confirm sparring is opt-in and headgear rules are clear. Check cancellation windows — peak classes fill and no-show fees apply.

## Practical tip
Train early morning or late evening. Midday pad rounds in outdoor-adjacent gyms cook beginners faster than the workout itself.
